mainEntity.name: What does a monthly CFO do?

acceptedAnswer.text: A monthly CFO provides recurring senior finance leadership, including reporting review, performance interpretation, forecasting support, and management decision support.

mainEntity.name: Is Monthly CFO London the same as Fractional CFO London?

acceptedAnswer.text: Monthly CFO London usually describes a recurring monthly engagement, while Fractional CFO London is a broader term for part-time CFO support.

mainEntity.name: Who is this service best suited to?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is best suited to growing businesses that need stronger reporting, better cash visibility, and senior finance leadership without hiring a full-time CFO.

mainEntity.name: What should a business expect each month?

acceptedAnswer.text: A business should expect structured reporting, commentary, review of key numbers, and clearer links between finance data and management decisions.

mainEntity.name: Can this work with our current accountant or finance team?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A monthly CFO can work alongside an existing accountant, finance manager, or outsourced finance resource to add leadership, interpretation, and structure.

mainEntity.name: When is a monthly CFO a better choice than a full-time hire?

acceptedAnswer.text: A monthly CFO is often a better fit when a business needs senior finance guidance regularly but is not ready for the cost or commitment of a full-time CFO.
